files.name: motion-prompt-130.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Wave text" (ウェーブテキスト), one of the names in "Motion graphics moves, part 2".
Motion Prompt #130

What it is: Letters rise and fall in turn, like a wave
What the sample shows: The letters of "WAVE TEXT" rise and fall one after another, like a wave.
Spec:
- "WAVE TEXT" (70 px, bold, 4 px letter spacing). Three waves per 4.7 s (1.567 s per wave).
- Vertical offset of letter i = −28·sin(φ − 0.62i), with φ = 2π × 3 × time ÷ 4.7 (each letter lags the previous by 0.62 rad).
- Rising letters stretch vertically (1 + 0.06·s) and shift from white towards yellow (s is the sine value, clamped to 0–1 for the colour).
- A shadow ellipse under each letter shrinks as the letter rises.
When to use it: Use it on a logo, a short heading or a caption timed to music, to add fun and rhythm.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/130.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/motion2.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
